description: This file defines a generic interface for catalog lookup data services in a Blazor application, providing an asynchronous method to retrieve a list of lookup data items.

classes.name: ICatalogLookupDataService
classes.description: A generic interface for a data service that provides catalog lookup data, with a method to asynchronously list all lookup data items.

methods.name: List
methods.description: An asynchronous method that retrieves a list of lookup data items of type TLookupData.
